thread:
incident-bot: Pager alert: Elevated 5xx + timeouts hitting /v1/generate (ingress) — 5m spike, error rate ~18% :rotating_light:
anya (oncall): I'm on it, starting initial scoped mitigation. can someone grab recent kvlogs + sample correlation ids?
mike (runtime): grabbing kvlogs now. initial graphs show p50 latency steady but p95 and error rate spiking around 16:12 UTC. sending a short kvlog bundle to /s3/log-drops/3091234567/kvlogs.tar.gz
raj (gateway): seeing a pattern — upstream POST -> model-worker returning 502 occasionally, but we also have gateway retries amplifying fanned requests. putting a hold on client-side retry proxy for 30s to stop retry amplification.
anya (oncall): thanks @raj — please post the command you ran so we can reproduce mitigations in runbook.
raj (gateway): ran: ```kubectl patch deploy ingress-proxy -n prod --type=json -p='[{"op":"replace","path":"/spec/template/spec/containers/0/env/RETRY_ENABLED","value":"false"}]'``` throttled new requests at the proxy layer.
sarah (sre): confirm impact: after disabling retries the 5xx rate dropped from 18% -> 6% in the next 2m. CPU on some model workers still elevated.
leo (support): customers seeing timeouts when requests get retried (duplication). which correlation ids should we look at to tie user impact?
mike (runtime): sample correlation ids: `corr=abe7f3c4`, `corr=b5d2a9ff`, `corr=c12d4440` — attaching small KV snippets for each: ```[abe7f3c4] gateway->ingress POST 16:11:59 upstream conn reset
[b5d2a9ff] retry loop 3x, final upstream 502
[c12d4440] long queue wait -> timeout 15s
```
anya (oncall): hypothesis A: upstream worker instability + retry amplification causing effective load spike -> downstream queue exhaustion. Hypothesis B: a recent model-worker config change increased mem usage -> GC stalls producing 502s. we should run a timeline.
devops-bot: Uploaded timeline artifact: https://internal.redwood/snapshots/3091234567/timeline.html (kvlogs + traces)
anya (oncall): mike/raj can you slice by region and model-version in the timeline? need to confirm whether this is single-worker/regional or global.
mike (runtime): slicing now -- early indications: 90% of 502s from region us-west-2 and model-ver v1.7.2 (recent rollout at 15:45 UTC).
raj (gateway): rolling back routing for v1.7.2 -> v1.7.1 for us-west-2, applying canary fallback. command: ```curl -X POST https://platform/api/route/rollback -d '{"model":"text-gen","from":"v1.7.2","to":"v1.7.1","region":"us-west-2"}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer ***'```
anya (oncall): setting timeline milestones: 15:45 deploy v1.7.2, 16:10 first 502 spike, 16:12 retries amplified, 16:14 disabled proxy retries, 16:16 rollback routing started.
sarah (sre): monitoring metrics: request errors returning to baseline after rollback; p95 latency trending down. creating an incident postmortem doc draft.
leo (support): sharing customer-facing status note: "We're investigating elevated 5xx errors affecting model generation in us-west-2; mitigation in progress. We'll update with timeline and root cause."
mike (runtime): for RCA we should include: a) kvlogs showing conn reset pattern b) model-worker GC logs during 15:45-16:05 c) gateway retry policy change causing amplification. I'll attach the GC excerpt (snippet): ```[v1.7.2] 2026-03-15T15:59:23.456Z GC pause 2450ms; memory spike to 6.3GB -> OOM margin low```
anya (oncall): agreed. tagging hypotheses in the thread: H1: regression in v1.7.2 causing GC pauses -> 502s. H2: ramped retries at gateway amplified failures into cascade. H3: network flakiness in us-west-2 causing intermittent conn resets (less likely given GC evidence).
devops-bot: Log bundle uploaded: s3://redwood-incident-archives/3091234567/logs.tar.gz (includes kvlogs, gateway traces, worker-gc logs).
raj (gateway): follow-up action: revert retry-enabled flag to true after rollback stabilizes, and add short-circuit guard to avoid retrying on connection-reset errors specifically. filing PR: #8483 to change retry policy.
anya (oncall): final status for now: mitigation = rollback to v1.7.1 + disable proxy retries during stabilization. customer impact: partial for ~25min in us-west-2, some requests timed out or returned 5xx. next steps: postmortem with root cause analysis + checklist to prevent retry amplification.
sarah (sre): assigning postmortem owners: mike (runtime) + raj (gateway) + anya (scribe). timeline and artifacts linked in the incident doc.
leo (support): I'll push the status update to customer channels once postmortem draft is ready. :thumbsup:
anya (oncall): closing live handoff — switching to RCA channel for deep analysis. thanks everyone for quick actions.
